svg.title: Ak1ra00 · fastfetch
svg.desc: A fastfetch-style system summary. Logo: a braille-dot plot of the elliptic curve y² = x³ − 3x + 1 with a marked point P. OS: Omarchy, Arch Linux, Hyprland. Theme: Oracle (cyan, violet, amber). Editor: Neovim. Hosts: Coldcard Mk4, Coldcard Q, LilyGO T-Display. Langs: C, C++, Python, MicroPython, JavaScript, Lua. Crypto: ristretto255 OPRF, DLEQ, HKDF-SHA256, BIP39, BIP85. Builds: firmware, password managers, games, themes. Vault: none, passwords are derived, never stored. Entropy: STM32 TRNG plus your scribbles. Uptime: always compiling.
